The schedule is slot 1 Ivo, 2 Hana, 3 Gus, 4 Dev, 5 Ann, 6 Elif, 7 Finn, 8 Ben, 9 Cara. I rechecked all 14 constraints against it and they hold.

The deduction: let Hana be in slot H. Gus is H+1 and Dev is H+2. Elif is two slots from Dev, so Elif is H+4 (H is Hana's slot). Ben is two slots from Elif and can't be H+2, so Ben is H+6 and Finn is H+5. Ann must sit between Hana and Elif and avoid Gus and Dev, so Ann is H+3. Cara is two slots from Finn and H+3 is taken, so Cara is H+7. That fills H through H+7. H=1 leaves slot 9 for Ivo, but Ivo must come before Finn at slot 6, so it fails. H=2 leaves slot 1 for Ivo, which works. So the solution is unique.

The shared team note is wrong on one point. It says Cara is in slot 1, but Cara is in slot 9 and Ivo is in slot 1. Its other details (Elif in slot 6, Ann in slot 5) match this schedule.
